items.title: Adobe Releases Critical Security Updates for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This security bulletin addresses 11 vulnerabilities, including five classified as Critical. CVE-2026-103849, with a CVSS score of 10.0, allows unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code, and CVE-2026-92909 affects Adobe Commerce B2B with a CVSS score of 9.8.

items.title: Critical PHP Vulnerability Hits Magento, WooCommerce and Other Ecommerce Platforms
items.summary: Two critical security holes in PHP, the underlying software for most online stores including Magento, were disclosed. These vulnerabilities, rated 9.2 out of 10, allow attacks without login or stolen passwords, and updates exist for PHP 8.2 to 8.5.

items.title: StyleSmuggler: Magento and Adobe Commerce 0-day RCE under active attack
items.summary: Sansec discovered StyleSmuggler, a Magento and Adobe Commerce zero-day (CVE-2026-75650, CVSS 10.0) that allows unauthenticated attackers remote code execution and was under active exploitation. Adobe released an emergency hotfix on September 7th, 2026.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce | APSB26-146
items.summary: Adobe released a critical security update (APSB26-146) affecting Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source, specifically a hotfix for CVE-2026-75650. This hotfix addresses an Improper Neutralisation of Special Elements Used in a Template Engine vulnerability leading to unauthenticated remote code execution.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce | APSB26-138
items.summary: This security update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities, including stored cross-site scripting (CVE-2026-76200, CVE-2026-76201, CVSS 9.3) and incorrect authorization flaws. Successful exploitation could result in security feature bypass and privilege escalation.

items.title: Adobe patches critical Magento account takeover (APSB26-92)
items.summary: Adobe released isolated patch files for APSB26-92, fixing seven vulnerabilities. Five are rated Critical, including CVE-2026-71362 (CVSS 9.1), an unauthenticated customer account takeover that allows attackers to switch customer sessions and access private data.

items.title: SessionReaper, unauthenticated RCE in Magento & Adobe Commerce
items.summary: SessionReaper (CVE-2025-54236, CVSS 9.1) is a critical flaw in all versions of Adobe Commerce and Magento that allows customer account takeover and unauthenticated remote code execution under certain conditions. Automated attacks were observed six weeks after initial publication, with PHP backdoors uploaded via /customer/address_file/upload.

items.title: PolyShell: unrestricted file upload in Magento and Adobe Commerce
items.summary: PolyShell (CVE-2026-48356, CVSS 9.6) is an unauthenticated unrestricted file upload vulnerability that could lead to arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, and security feature bypass. Sansec attributes 471 injections to this flaw in a campaign that infected 953 online stores.
